messages:
maria-ny: Heads-up — we need a safer per-org routing override flow for enterprise customers. Current ad-hoc header injection is causing support churn and weird telemetry gaps.

aj: +1. Can you sketch the UX you had in mind?

maria-ny: Thinking a three-state override in console: allowlist (pinned route), soft-shunt (canary fallback), emergency-shunt (immediate bypass). Each action creates an auditable change with TTL and reason.

lee: Important to include 'who approved' and a rollback button. Oncall needs a one-click escape hatch that won’t require infra churn.

ops-ux: UX notes — prefer in-line small modal with pre-filled reasons and quick TTL presets (1h, 6h, 24h). Also a clear visual flag in the route dashboard.

aj: From platform side, we also need header precedence rules documented. If org header and admin pin both exist, which wins? We should make admin pin take precedence and log the header that triggered the route.

kai: Telemetry ask: increment a counter for each override and emit span with tags {"override.type", "override.source", "actor"}. Also highlight in the per-route latency/cost dashboard that traffic is being shunted.

maria-ny: Example header we see in ops: `X-Redwood-Org-Override: shunt=emergency;actor=mike;ttl=3600`. We should avoid relying only on headers for audit. Console actions must write the same provenance to the audit log and emit a signed token for downstream routing decision.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: routing-service v3.7.1 rolled to canary at 1705728200.

lee: Security: require RBAC checks before the console shows emergency-shunt. Also require a 2nd approver for >24h TTL.

aj: Implementation sketch: store override record in overrides table (org_id, type, actor, expires_at, source="console"/"header"). Routing layer checks override cache and falls back to header only if no console record exists. Pseudocode:
```
override = cache.get(org_id)
if override && override.active:
  route = override.route
else:
  route = match_by_headers(request.headers)
```

ops-ux: Small request — show a diff in the route audit UI when an override is active so support can see original route vs active route at a glance.

maria-ny: Agree. Also add an 'auto-expire' indicator and email notification to org admins when emergency-shunt triggers.

kai: One more: metric names proposal -> `rdw.override.count`, `rdw.override.duration`, `rdw.override.origin.{console,header}`, `rdw.override.rollback_count`.

lee: I'll draft RBAC checks and approval flow. aj, can you validate the cache semantics for fast lookups?

aj: Yep — will prototype cache TTL + strong invalidation on rollback. Will ping when I have a PoC. :eyes:

maria-ny: Great — thanks team. I'll mock the modal and put a proto in /design before EOD tomorrow.

ops-ux: :thumbsup: Please add copy for the modal explaining risks (latency, cost, audit trail).

maria-ny: Will do. End of thread.
